metric: Time above 250 lx melanopic EDI during wake
state_and_placement_domain: Valid waking near-eye wear is primary; chest waking exposure is complementary; sleep is outside the metric domain
approved_action: Retain as a state-conditional duration with metric-specific support
estimand: Total observed supported waking-wear duration above 250 lx melanopic EDI
primary_rule: Project the canonical diary and wear intervals onto the complete true-minute grid; sum actual valid waking interval durations; terminate at state, wear, or gap boundaries; report the complete waking-state denominator; do not scale by coverage
reference_profile_use: Wake × placement MEDI profile diagnoses time-selective support only
sensitivity: Pooled profile primary; site-specific and leave-one-site-out profiles; eligible 70%/90% scenarios; paired chest complementary
failure_condition: Unbounded calendar-day diary-state domain, no wake state on a complete domain, inadequate valid waking support, or unresolved state/wear boundary; zero only for an adequately observed no-event wake window
retained_data_vs_metric_na: Metric-specific NA is reason-coded as incomplete_state_domain, no_state_window, or insufficient_state_support and does not remove the retained day or its non-wake metrics

rationale: This metric directly targets waking near-eye exposure, so its denominator is the interval-projected waking domain rather than source-present rows or the full day

state_and_placement_domain: Identical paired MEDI and photopic LIGHT minutes in the intentional hybrid day; near-eye primary and chest complementary
approved_action: Use the METRIC-010 arithmetic mean of viable momentary ratios with a metric-specific 50 percent viable-minute requirement
estimand: Arithmetic mean of one-minute MEDI/LIGHT ratios where both channels are finite and strictly positive
primary_rule: Place eligible measurements on a complete 1440-minute local wall-clock grid; average duplicated fall-back observations channel-wise within local minute; calculate MEDI/LIGHT only for finite strictly positive pairs; require at least 720 viable minutes; return the arithmetic mean of viable minute ratios; never scale weight or profile-correct MDER
reference_profile_use: No reference profile is used to calculate weight scale or gate MDER under METRIC-010
sensitivity: Use the same independently reconstructed mean-of-ratios construct in the gap-timing-unaware dataset; compare on common samples and run model-specific current-estimand upper-tail and influence checks; paired/common-sample chest is complementary
failure_condition: No viable momentary ratio or fewer than 720 viable paired minutes on the fixed local wall-clock grid
retained_data_vs_metric_na: Metric-specific reason-coded NA only; the participant-day and every other supported metric remain retained
baseline_verification: Independent R 4.6.1 reconstruction PASS on 2026-08-11; primary metric manifest 7bb2830c695e5600f0877acca500a187a040fe727a029bdb069f69099abe4f43; gap manifest 4ed62fbe58de65a6d05d8cfc6b5d870d7c74a3c83fe89bcd72bd1dd838698935; 137 near-eye and 152 chest participants represented in each estimable MDER scenario
rationale: The author intends moments to contribute equally before daily averaging; ratio of integrals instead weights moments by photopic illuminance and caused the pronounced upward shift; repaired primary and gap-timing-unaware common-day values are nearly identical under the shared formula

state_and_placement_domain: Intentional hybrid repeated-day grid; near-eye waking/pre-sleep and bedside sleep environment; chest complementary

primary_rule: Construct the expected one-hour grid; preserve missing hours; compare like clock hours across days; require at least three eligible days and at least 20 of 24 clock hours represented on at least two days; collapse a repeated fall-back wall hour only for the like-clock comparison
reference_profile_use: Fixed MEDI profile diagnoses systematic clock-bin support but does not fill the participant series
sensitivity: Pooled profile primary; site-specific and leave-one-site-out profiles; 70%/90% eligibility where regularity remains estimable; wake-only analysis is complementary because it changes the estimand
failure_condition: Fewer than three eligible days, fewer than 20 clock hours represented on at least two days, unresolved DST grid, or undefined total variance
retained_data_vs_metric_na: Participant-level metric-specific NA; participant-days remain in other analyses
baseline_verification: baseline/current; R-verified 2026-07-29 with R 4.6.1; not final

state_and_placement_domain: Intentional hybrid repeated-day grid; near-eye waking/pre-sleep and bedside sleep environment; chest complementary
approved_action: Retain only with true expected-interval adjacency on a regular one-hour absolute-time grid
estimand: Fragmentation of the participant's hybrid light series based on changes between truly adjacent supported hours
primary_rule: Construct the expected one-hour real-time grid; calculate differences only for timestamps separated by exactly one hour and within valid continuity; preserve both fall-back hours, gaps, and adjacent-pair support; require at least three eligible days and at least 24 adjacent pairs across three days
reference_profile_use: Fixed MEDI profile diagnoses systematic support but does not fill gaps or create adjacency
sensitivity: Pooled profile primary; site-specific and leave-one-site-out profiles; justified adjacency/gap sensitivity; wake-only analysis is complementary because it changes the estimand
failure_condition: Fewer than three eligible days, fewer than 24 true adjacent pairs across three days, unresolved DST/device boundary, or undefined variance denominator
retained_data_vs_metric_na: Participant-level metric-specific NA; participant-days remain in other analyses
baseline_verification: baseline/current; R-verified 2026-07-29 with R 4.6.1; not final
